messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — AtlasCorp POC just flipped to their private deployment slice and we started seeing auth failures + token refresh errors. Customer is blocked on completing SSQ and pricing decision. Can we get an urgent triage?

michael_eng: On it. Any logs / request ids?

sam_sales: See snippet they pasted: 
```
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"signature verification failed","request_id":"req_9f2b1"}
```

michael_eng: That looks like a key mismatch. Are they using our managed keys for Private or their KMS?

sam_sales: They said they wired up their KMS (customer-key) yesterday per guide.

nina_se: @michael_eng @devon_sre I think this is the KMS/HSM wrapping edge-case we saw once. Private control plane still needs the RSA pubkey in config. Can someone check the keystore on their node?

devon_sre: Pinging infra-bot to pull recent deploy + node state for atlas-prod-slice-47.

infra-bot: deploy: atlas-prod-slice-47 last_updated=2026-01-17T21:03:12Z, runtime=ri-0.14.2, kernel=kv-cache-v2

michael_eng: Okay two things: 1) ask customer to confirm KMS key-id matches the one in private-config.yaml; 2) I can run a local verify command if they share the JWK thumbprint.

sam_sales: They're sensitive about sharing keys. Can we do an automated check from our side?

nina_se: We can attempt a public-key fetch if their KMS exposes it. If not, request a signed test token from them: `curl -X POST https://private-ingest.atlascorp.example/sign-test -d '{"exp":60}'` -> they return a token we verify.

alice_prod: Also FYI they're asking about burst pricing for Dedicated if we can't stabilize Private soon. Sales wants a quote for 2k TPS reserved + 4k burst.

sam_sales: Correct. They need a pricing diff and unit economics before next Thurs.

devon_sre: Back to auth — I'm seeing 502s in the request path after token verify fails, stack snippet: 
```
ERR: session.init -> jwt.verify -> crypto.verify: RSA_verify failed (err=22)
caused by: wrong public key
```

michael_eng: That confirms it. Nina, can you drop the minimal doc snippet we can send to Atlas to help run the signed-test?

nina_se: Sending quick repro: 
1) curl to sign endpoint (customer-side) 
2) we run `ri verify-token --jwks-url https://their-kms.example/.well-known/jwks.json --token <token>`
If that passes, Private control plane health should return to normal.

sam_sales: I'm posting that to the customer now. Also attached their SSQ — they flagged that our SSQ doesn't show SOC2 Type II attestation date. Can we confirm?

alice_prod: We have SOC2 Type II completed 2025-11-05. I'll get the attestation PDF and point them to the compliance portal link.

sam_sales: Thank you. Customer asked if an exception can be made to start POC before attestation paperwork is finalized.

nina_se: Security-led exceptions require SOC1/2 proof or an NDA addendum. I'll loop legal if they insist. 

michael_eng: Quick note on metrics — during the spike we saw KV cache thrash and higher latency from 75ms -> 420ms which caused upstream retries and amplified errors. If auth is fixed but latency persists, we'll want to enable prefix caching and conservative batching.

devon_sre: I'll flip `prefix_cache: true` on their runtime for one hour (safe toggle) and monitor. infra-bot, please run the toggle.

infra-bot: run: toggle-config --cluster atlas-prod-slice-47 --set prefix_cache=true --owner devon_sre -> started

sam_sales: Customer just replied with a signed token (redacted). Passing to michael_eng.

michael_eng: Verified locally with `ri verify-token` — signature good, issuer ok. That means their KMS is fine for this token. We should compare the public key used by control plane.

nina_se: Found mismatch in their private-config.yaml: `jwks_url` pointed to an older key rotation endpoint `/.well-known/jwks-old.json`. Requesting them to rotate pointer.

sam_sales: Sent note asking them to update pointer and redeploy. They've asked about whether rotation can be hot-swapped without downtime.

devon_sre: Yes — we support hot rotate for JWKS if they have zero-downtime deployment. Recommend a two-step: publish new key, update control plane to accept both keys for 15m, then remove old key.

alice_prod: Also looping finance — they'll need a provisional quote for the Dedicated burst scenario. @sam_sales can you open a quick pricing request with expected GA dates?

sam_sales: Done — I'll create the MQL and tag finance.

infra-bot: toggle-config complete. prefix_cache=true on atlas-prod-slice-47. Latency monitoring: baseline 82ms -> now 96ms.

michael_eng: Good — the cache helped. Once JWKS pointer is updated and control plane restarts (no data loss expected), errors should clear.

sam_sales: Customer redeployed and reports errors dropped to near zero. They still want the SOC2 attestation doc and a short note on burst pricing.

alice_prod: I'll email attestation + compliance portal link in 30m. Finance to follow with provisional burst quote by EOD.

nina_se: Filing a brief postmortem entry: cause = stale jwks pointer after KMS rotation; mitigations = add JWKS healthcheck + warning in config guide, and a small doc snippet for signed-test.

devon_sre: Recommend an automated alert if token-verify failures exceed 0.5% for 5m. I'll open a ticket.

sam_sales: Thanks all — customer is unblocked and wants a short exec summary for their procurement team. I'll draft and circulate. :thumbsup:
